replace_entry.reason: The current generic definition collapses paper and repository objects.
replace_entry.replacement_policy: Use a qualified term from proposed_entries whenever the layer matters. CM alone is an umbrella label only after the object has been identified.

proposed_entries.plain_definition: A complete 2x2 binary pattern representing one two-input Boolean function under the paper's declared state order.
proposed_entries.technical_definition: One of the sixteen matrices in Figure 1, indexed by X/not-X and Y/not-Y operand states.
proposed_entries.common_confusion: One cell is one state-pair output; the complete four-cell matrix is the operator.

proposed_entries.plain_definition: A paper-defined matrix whose entries are logical expressions rather than final bits.
proposed_entries.technical_definition: An expression-valued measurement matrix whose entrywise positive valuation produces a corresponding CM in the paper's framework.
proposed_entries.common_confusion: An LM is not already the binary CM produced from it.

proposed_entries.plain_definition: A larger binary matrix obtained by positively valuing a larger paper-defined logical matrix.
proposed_entries.technical_definition: The valued result of the paper's projection/tensor/modifier construction under a declared state order; formal Section 5.2 uses square power-of-two dimensions.
proposed_entries.common_confusion: It is not one of the sixteen elementary two-input operator CMs and is not automatically an arbitrary repository rectangle.

proposed_entries.plain_definition: The repository's complete row-column grid of exact Boolean outputs over ordered row and column variables.
proposed_entries.technical_definition: A dense Boolean array produced by alignment to ordered R+C and reshape to 2^|R| by 2^|C|.
proposed_entries.common_confusion: This implementation contract is not the paper's general dimensional definition.

proposed_entries.plain_definition: A neutral name for a grid whose row and column labels encode parts of each complete assignment.
proposed_entries.technical_definition: A dense 2^|R| by 2^|C| truth-valued array interpreted with ordered R, C, bit-order, and fixed-context metadata.
proposed_entries.common_confusion: The matrix shape alone does not identify its variables, order, or construction history.

proposed_entries.plain_definition: A row index and column index locating one entry in a declared layout.
proposed_entries.technical_definition: The integer pair obtained by accumulating assignment bits MSB-first over ordered R and C sequences in the repository lookup contract.
proposed_entries.common_confusion: A coordinate is not the stored output and cannot recover an assignment without the layout metadata.

deprecated_foundational_word.replacement: coordinate, row index, or column index
deprecated_foundational_word.exception: A later software lesson may define address explicitly as an analogy; it is not used in this mini-arc.
